title: われは海の子 (Wareha Umino Ko — I Am a Child of the Sea)
description: A stirring 1914 song about a child raised by the sea, from a pine forest cottage on the rocky shore. Born bathed in salt, lulled to sleep by waves, and grown up gazing out over the vast ocean — the singer knows the sea as their true home. Originally seven verses, the first two are most commonly sung today in Japanese schools.
